column2: By-Law on Mobile Trading in Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha Authoritative Area
This  by-law  is  enacted  to  regulate,  administrate,  inspect  on  the  business  of  food  and  other  goods  by  mobile
trading within the authoritative area of Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha.
This by-law is known as the by-law of mobile trading of Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha.

3.(1)  No person shall sell food or any other goods in the area of authority of the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha unless

column2: there is a license obtained from the Chairman in the form specified in the first schedule of this by-law.

3.(2)  Every person applying for a license under this section shall submit to Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha a completed

column2: application form prescribed in the first schedule of this by-law.
